summary: Full-stack engineer who ships production code from frontend to infrastructure. I helped architect a multi-tenant SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies, today design and run the distributed platform behind Slovakia's national e-government, and build my own products end to end. Comfortable owning a feature from UI through API, data model and the AWS/Kubernetes it runs on — with observability baked in.

experience.name: LiveAgent

On the leadership team for two years — set architecture, mentored engineers and ran hiring.
Owned features from design through production and on-call.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform

Built end-to-end observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) so failures surface before users feel them.
